title: Checkout
summary: The checkout screen: confirms the signed-in customer's details and takes payment for the cart, creating an Order. Populated by hand from Customer alex-green + the pending Order 1050 (ZZ Plant, EUR 28). Also renders the two honest failure states this screen owns — payment declined (branch paymentFailed) and sold-out-at-checkout (branch outOfStockAtCheckout).
